overlap.a_name: Okatie – McIntosh 115kV Tie: Add Series Reactor
overlap.b_name: MCINTOSH 230 KV, BREAKER CONTROL RELAY UPGRADES
overlap.touch_detail: The Okatie–McIntosh 115 kV tie line names McIntosh as an endpoint. The DESC series reactor work is at new Deerfield Switching Station, location not stated; the SERTP relay work is at the McIntosh 230 kV bus (SCRTP Planned Facilities 2026-2030 $2M & Above, p. 41; SERTP 2025 Regional Transmission Plan (Nov 26 2025), p. 107).
overlap.can_share: Verify work locations before reviewing possible coordination; shared assets unverified.

savings.basis: Estimated coordination saving on printed plan cost; partner cost not stated for desc-p41 ($5,376,418); team-assumed 1%-3% of this known scope only; shared savings unverified.

properties.name: Okatie – McIntosh 115kV Tie: Add Series Reactor
properties.description: Construct Deerfield Switching Station and Install a 9% series reactor on the Okatie – McIntosh 115kV Tie Line.
properties.need: This project is needed to improve system performance and to meet NERC TPL and internal DESC Planning Criteria for reliability.
properties.location_source: Straight line between Hand-placed from HIFLD Electric Power Transmission Lines, TAP170160 (data/raw/hifld_lines_ga_sc.geojson); SCRTP Planned Facilities 2026-2030, pp. 11-12: INFERRED - junction on the Jasper-Yemassee 230 kV line (HIFLD TAP170160); DESC plans to fold that line into Okatie. Verify on Dominion's Jasper-Okatie route map. / OpenStreetMap

properties.name: MCINTOSH 230 KV, BREAKER CONTROL RELAY UPGRADES
properties.description: Replace existing twenty230 kV breaker control relays with twenty high speed breaker control relays at the McIntosh 230 kV breaker and a half bus.
properties.need: Protection analysis identified the project modifications are required due to the interconnection of the proposed generating facility.

savings.basis: Estimated coordination saving on printed plan cost; partner cost not stated for desc-p41 ($5,376,418); team-assumed 1%-3% of this known scope only; shared savings unverified.
